caseNameFull: Elliott, Individually and as Next Friend of Elliott, a Minor v. Lewin

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Tex. Motion of appellee Hillcrest Baptist Hospital for damages and double costs denied. Motion of appellee Marcial Lewin for damages and double costs denied. Appeal dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
